name: WorldUtils::WallProductFlag10
notes: Lane RZ. The wall product of an id (catalog slot 26 with (id, 0), through the catalog singleton's slot 16) and its slot 10 byte, 0 when there is no product. Difftest WorldCatalog_ProductHelpers (4000 seeded cases with the fake catalog: product present or missing, every slot call logged and compared). Mutation check: its mutant (slot 11 for 10) killed.

name: WorldUtils::WallProductFlag11
notes: Lane RZ. As WallProductFlag10 with the product's slot 11 byte; 0 without a product. Difftest WorldCatalog_ProductHelpers. Mutation check: its mutant (1 when missing) killed.

name: WorldUtils::WallPartitionValue
notes: Lane RZ. The key is the default wall id when the id's kind is -1, else the id; 0.0f unless the key's kind is 1 or 3; then partitions (world DB slot 39) slot 84 (float, key) gives the float. Difftest WorldCatalog_ProductHelpers (float result compared bit for bit, slot logs compared). Mutation check: its 2 mutants (the -1 kind test, the kind tested on the id rather than the key) killed.

name: WorldUtils::WallProductResource
notes: Lane RZ. The id's holder (catalog slot 31), its product through the holder's vbtable (holder + 4 + vbtable[6]), else the default product (slot 27); the product's resource (slot 9) when its name (slot 8) is non-empty and the resource non-zero, else 0. Difftest WorldCatalog_ProductHelpers (holders with and without products, empty and missing names). Mutation check: its 4 mutants (vbtable offset, no default product, empty name accepted, result on failure) killed.

name: WorldUtils::AnyPartitionHas
notes: Lane RZ. False without partitions (world DB slot 39); else true when any of the partitions' slot 55 count records (slot 56 copies record i into a 24-byte local) has slot 50 (&record) equal to *id. Difftest WorldCatalog_ProductHelpers (record contents logged instead of their stack addresses). Mutation check: its 3 mutants (one record short, true without partitions, != for ==) killed.
